name: Easywpkit Paid Content Access
author: easywpkit

sections.description:
Easywpkit Paid Content Access lets you hide text, images, or videos until a visitor pays (via Stripe, PayPal, etc.) or until a logged-in user with the correct role is detected. A beautiful, customizable Gutenberg block does all the work.

Features

  • Three lock modes: Payment, Roles, or Both.
  • Automatic payment return handling.
  • Cover image, typography, and button styling controls.
  • Classic Editor shortcode: [ewpkcl_lock payment_url=”…” button_text=”Buy Now”]
  • No usage limits or licenses required.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin and activate it.
  2. Go to Content Lock → Settings and enter the URL of the page where you placed the [ewpkcl_payment_handler] shortcode.
  3. Add the “Content Lock” block in the editor, configure your payment link and appearance.
sections.faq:
How to set up payment return?

Create a page with the shortcode [ewpkcl_payment_handler], note its URL, and paste it into Settings. Then generate the Stripe return URL inside the block inspector.
